wiki.title: Melanie Levin
wiki.extract: Melanie Ross Levin is an American politician. She is a Democratic member of the Delaware House of Representatives, representing district 10 since 2024. She is also director of the Delaware State Office of Women's Advancement and Advocacy and director of engagement and mobilization at the National Women's Law Center. She is Jewish.
